scripts.start: npm run db:deploy && npm run start --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/bot/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/mark-deploying.js && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
